title: K133589: SOMATOM Force, 510(k) summary and clearance letter

passages.note: Drafting date is 21 November 2013. The Force is compared with Definition Flash K121072. The larger arrays and paired Vectron tubes are described, together with an extension of the earlier beam-hardening correction.
passages.quote: an extension of the Posterior Fossa Optimization (PFO) feature
